subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a lock is requested for a feature draft that is not ready, the system shall refuse the lock and name every unmet readiness condition.
rationale: Nothing locks until the loop has converged (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-3)
fit_criterion: One fixture per readiness condition in FR-12 through FR-14, FR-16, and FR-38 through FR-42 is refused naming exactly that condition; a fixture failing all of them names all of them; zero locks are granted to drafts that are not ready.
